scope: Three rule-based recipes on synthetic material. No language-model Director and no generative steps.

checks.name: three recipes are listed with parameter schemas and state plainly that no language model is used
without beat data the recipe refuses and says what to run first; with it, the plan lists steps, the data it rests on (tempo, confidence, method) and alternatives — and changes nothing

steps: Place 8 picture clips, one every 4 beat(s), order: sequence
basis: 31 beats of the music clip (120.2 BPM, confidence 0.988)
method: spectral-flux onsets + dynamic-programming beat tracking (no model); assumes a steady pulse

checks.name: apply: one revision; picture cuts fall on bar lines of the real beat grid (within one frame), alternating between the chosen assets; the run is recorded
whole-task undo: one undo removes every clip the recipe placed and its run record; redo brings them back
regenerate with new settings: the two hand-edited clips are kept byte-for-byte (trim and effect intact), every untouched clip is replaced, the new cut is denser, nothing overlaps, one revision
one undo of the regeneration restores the previous cut exactly
a plan made for an older revision is refused; an observer cannot apply a recipe
social pack: adds three formats and a loudness target in one step, says no captions were added because there is no transcript, and refuses to run twice with nothing left to do

steps: Set the loudness target to -14 LUFS

checks.name: after a transcript exists the same recipe plans only the missing part (captions)
tidy speech: measured pauses are removed from every track, captions from the transcript are shown, loudness set to -16 — one step, one undo

steps: Remove 8 pause(s), 5.1 s in total, from every track (keeping 0.12 s around speech)
Set the loudness target to -16 LUFS

checks.name: agent previews a recipe, regenerates the existing run with other settings (protected clips reported), and sees the run in the summary

plan: Place 4 picture clips, one every 8 beat(s), order: sequence

checks.name: editor: preview shows steps and alternatives; apply places the clips; after a hand edit, regenerate with another setting keeps that clip (shown as 1 protected) and re-cuts the rest; Ctrl+Z undoes the regeneration
